# Words understood

::: {.callout-note}
Drafted by an LLM-based AI tool (Claude Code/Fable 5.1). Revised by OpenAI Codex/GPT-6. Outline with one worked example.

<!--

For a child aged `{python} years_months(36)` drawn from the modelled population, the model places half its predicted counts `{python} interval_at(36, "understood")` words on the `{python} N_WORDS`-word reference scale. The middle estimate is `{python} median_at(36, "understood")` words. The model predicts 50 words or fewer for about `{python} one_in_below(36, "understood", 50)` such children.
